article.headline: Dillon Bailey scores 19 to help Wofford cruise to 81-62 victory over Furman
article.description: — Dillon Bailey scored 19 points as Wofford beat Furman 81-62 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Dillon Bailey scores 19 to help Wofford cruise to 81-62 victory over Furman
article.story: GREENVILLE, S.C. -- — Dillon Bailey scored 19 points as Wofford beat Furman 81-62 on Monday night. Bailey added six rebounds for the Terriers (9-8, 3-1 Southern Conference). Corey Tripp added 16 points and six rebounds. Jackson Sivills scored 12. Charles Johnston led the way for the Paladins (14-3, 2-2) with 14 points and seven rebounds. Nick Anderson added 12 points and three steals. Garrett Hien had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
